warnings.message: Channel 'google_shopping' spend mostly follows the season or trend (62% of its movement), so it is hard to separate from seasonality.
Channel 'google_pmax' spend mostly follows the season or trend (77% of its movement), so it is hard to separate from seasonality.
Channel 'google_display' is active in only 2% of weeks; its estimate will be wide.
9 channels and 8 controls is a lot for 116 weeks; expect wide intervals.

benchmark.method: the same weeks a year earlier, scaled for growth

source.citation: Anderson, Anthony (2024). Multi-Region Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) Dataset for Several eCommerce Brands. figshare. Dataset.
